# From landscape
to Bower.

The structure is finished once. The garden never is.

A hollow under a beech. A cave mouth above a beach. A path beneath an arch of hedge.

## None of them
finished. All of
them alive.

![Concept visualisation of a shaded woodland garden room within a timber lattice](/assets/selected/21-woodland-bower.webp)

Timber, then leaves, then a room of blossom.

## The garden continues
the architecture.

## Five acts of
making.

-

### 1. Conversation

Landscape, people, purpose.

-

### 2. Founding Site Study

Four weeks · £65,000 GBP plus approved travel and project expenses.

-

### 3. Design

Geometry, structure, planting.

-

### 4. Making

Fabrication and assembly.

-

### 5. Stewardship

Training, growth, care.

![Concept visualisation of a newly installed timber Bower with young planting](/assets/selected/25-new-bower.webp)

## Every
landscape asks
for a different
answer.
